text:
lucy: Heads up — console hourly usage graphs are ~3h behind for several tenants. Got a support-bot alert at 09:10 about 'hourly-rollup delay'. Can we triage? :eyes:
vikram: seeing it too. Dashboard shows a gap from 02:00–05:00 UTC in hourly_rollups. Looks like backfill jobs were retried repeatedly.
jack: any obvious errors in the ETL coordinator? I can jump on infra if there's a retry flood.
ops-bot: alert: usage-ingest-backfill retry count exceeded threshold for job backfill-2026-03-17-02 (count=24).
tara: S3 PUTs had a bunch of 503s around 02:12–02:18 UTC during the backfill window. Could be a downstream throttling origin.
matt: quick grep of worker logs shows repeated JSONDecodeError for one event id: `event_id=abc123` — same stacktrace each retry.
jack: paste the stack snippet?
matt: ```
ERROR ETL.Worker - Failed to apply backfill batch (id=backfill-2026-03-17-02)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/etl/worker.py", line 214, in process_batch
    record = json.loads(msg.payload)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
```
vikram: that would cause the batch to fail and the coordinator to requeue. If retries are infinite or high it stalls downstream aggregation.
lucy: affected customers flagged in support queue: acme-inc, betahealth, quickchat. Need comms + ETA.
jack: temp mitigation — we can mark that event as 'poison' and skip it, then kick the backfill to re-run. I can run an offset skip script.
tara: confirm we also need to address S3 503 root cause afterward. But skipping the bad event should unblock rolling hourly counts.
matt: command to skip: `python tools/poison_skipper.py --job backfill-2026-03-17-02 --event abc123` — will mark it as skipped in coordinator DB.
vikram: while jack runs that, I'll validate hourly_rollups for the affected tenant with this query: `SELECT tenant_id, hour, count_rows FROM analytics.hourly_rollups WHERE hour >= '2026-03-17 01:00' AND hour <= '2026-03-17 06:00' ORDER BY hour;`
jack: executed skip, coordinator accepted. Kicked a manual backfill run for the remaining batches. Watching progress.
ops-bot: event: backfill-2026-03-17-02 manual run started by jack.
vikram: logs show batch processing resumed, consumer lag dropping. Should see console charts start to populate in ~20–30m as rollups flush.
lucy: sending interim note to affected customers: "We're investigating delayed usage metrics; root cause a malformed event caused backfill retries. We're running a manual backfill; charts should update in ~30–45 minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem"
jack: confirming: after backfill finishes we should run `VACUUM ANALYZE analytics.hourly_rollups;` and trigger the dashboard cache invalidation job: `POST /internal/cache/invalidate?scope=hourly-rollups`
tara: filed infra ticket to look at S3 503 spike (TICKET-5821). Also opening a short postmortem draft.
matt: noted a small code fix to add better validation and skip-on-decode-failure in the worker (PR incoming).
lucy: thanks all. If anyone sees new tenant errors ping #oncall. I'll update the support threads once charts start filling. :thumbsup:
